notes: SOURCE reason: the unconditional Level Sweep Reversal (sweep of yesterday's / pre-market high-low, close back through the level by >= 5 pts, stop at the sweep extreme, 1.35R target) was closed six times as a raw effect; Scan 033 then showed that on days after a COMPRESSED prior session (prior_day_narrow, the validated hyp-000048 state) the same trade ran +0.030R net over 131 trades while non-compressed days ran -0.065R over 343. name: H118 VWAP-distance drift lineage, measured against the correct baseline
source_channel: revamp list top (directive s.9 names it)
lineage: hyp-000121/122/123 (H118: vwap_dist_vs_atr LOW tercile, 10-day drift); research/studies/h118-baseline-diagnostic-2026-09-12.md; research/mechanisms/h118-vwap-dist-low.md
notes: SOURCE reason: price far below its volume-weighted average forces marginal sellers out and leaves willing buyers, so a 10-day drift up should follow. H118 passed every old gate and was then REJECTED (September 12th) because its LOW-tercile drift was not distinguishable from NQ's OWN 10-day drift (LOW minus ALL +0.116, CI (-0.263,+0.490)). The correct baseline for the trade is that own-drift number, not zero: a strategy is only worth paper if it beats simply being long NQ for the same 10 days. SPECIFY builds the trade (entry at the LOW-tercile signal, 10-session time exit, stop from the VXN->next-session-range fact) and SCREEN reports net R AND net R minus the same-horizon unconditional drift. The frozen H118 forward log is untouched (scope boundary); this is a new candidate.

name: Opening-range width -> midday excursion (hyp-000162) as a STOP/SIZING INPUT
source_channel: revamp list top (directive s.9 names it -- input, not a standalone strategy)
notes: SOURCE reason: a wide first 30 minutes predicts a busier midday. That is a magnitude fact, not a direction, so it is NOT a strategy: it is queued as an INPUT -- a rule that widens the stop / reduces size of whichever strategy in paper trades through midday (S001's time exit window, S003's holding period). It advances only attached to a host strategy's FIX ONCE or a new candidate's SPECIFY; it never gets its own paper slot.
